issues.issue: Empty-body items render as blank 'white' nodes in the brain graph
issues.fix: Skip empty-body items from the brain (or backfill a one-line description) so they stop appearing as contentless dots.

issues.issue: Title collisions: distinct items share one note name and overwrite each other
issues.fix: De-duplicate or suffix colliding titles so each item is its own note.
sample: Codebase Knowledge Graph for Claude Code Token Savings

issues.issue: Oversized category hubs become hairballs in the graph view
issues.fix: Sub-bucket big categories (cap members per hub, add sub-hubs) so the graph stays readable.

issues.issue: Version-less bare vendor names kept as tools
issues.fix: Re-derive an exact version for each, or fold into the proper product record.

issues.issue: Connectors with no URL/source can't be installed or verified
issues.fix: Resolve each connector's repo/package URL (or drop it).
